newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN BEAT HAMBURG BUT STUTTGART STAY TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN BEAT HAMBURG BUT STUTTGART STAY TOP.

text.p: Goals from Alexander Zickler and Christian Nerlinger gave Bayern Munich a 2-1 home win over old rivals Hamburg on Saturday, keeping Giovanni Trapattoni's side in third place in the Bundesliga.
VfB Stuttgart's 4-2 win over Freiburg on Friday night, achieved despite playing with 10 men for most of the match, ensured they retain top spot, with 22 points from nine games.
Bayer Leverkusen kept up their charge with a 4-1 demolition of Hansa Rostock on Friday and lie a point behind Stuttgart in second and a point ahead of Bayern.

Cologne, who started the day in fourth place, crashed to a 3-0 defeat at rapidly improving Duisburg while promoted Arminia Bielefeld chalked up their first win of the season, beating Werder Bremen 3-1.
Fellow newcomers Bochum beat champions Borussia Dortmund 1-0 on Friday.
